null_value_notice: 全部 baseline 与 target 一律为 null，且 schema 将其类型约束为 null，任何数值都无法在不修改 schema 的前提下悄悄写入。公布测量协议不等于公布目标：口径、采集主体角色、频率与发布门槛属于方法，目标值属于主管部门决策。缺少输入时指标保持 unassigned，不插值、不用区级平均值替代。

protocols.definition_zh: 法定容积率：由主管部门审定的地上计容建筑面积与用地面积之比。
protocols.definition_en: Statutory floor area ratio: approved above-ground countable floor area over land area.
protocols.sampling_scope: 总体设计范围内每一控规单元
protocols.frequency_or_trigger: 控规批复或调整后一次性赋值
protocols.denominator: 该单元的法定用地面积
protocols.missing_value_handling: 输入缺失时保持 unassigned，不插值、不以区级或全市平均值替代、不以历史值顺延。
quality_checks: 与批复文件逐单元核对
单元面积之和与官方边界面积一致
计容规则与批复口径一致
protocols.dispute_review: 任何居民、维护者、开发者或独立复核角色可在公开值班簿提出质疑；由独立复核角色复算并公开复算过程，原值与更正值并列保留。
protocols.privacy_and_retention: 仅使用公开批复文件中的数值，不涉及个人数据；发布时一并标注批复文号。
publication_gate: 控规批复已公开
官方用地边界已发布
计容规则口径已明确
protocols.assignment_precondition: 审定控规批复与官方用地边界。
protocols.aggregation_method_zh: 不适用统计估计——法定审定值，逐控规单元登记原值。**多单元并存时不加权平均成一个数**：全带只有一个容积率数字必然掩盖单元差异，故按单元并列呈现。
protocols.aggregation_method_en: No statistical estimation applies — a statutory approved value, recorded per control-plan unit. **Units are not averaged into a single figure**: one belt-wide FAR would necessarily hide unit-level differences, so units are listed side by side.
protocols.privacy_and_retention_en: Uses only figures from published approval documents; no personal data involved. The approval document number is published alongside the value.
quality_checks_en: Checked unit by unit against the approval document
Sum of unit areas matches the official boundary area
Countable-floor-area rules match the approval basis
publication_gate_en: The control-plan approval is published
The official land boundary is released
The countable-floor-area basis is stated
protocols.sampling_scope_en: every control-plan unit within the overall design area
protocols.frequency_or_trigger_en: assigned once after the control plan is approved or revised

protocols.definition_zh: 最高建筑高度：主管部门审定的分区高度上限。
protocols.definition_en: Maximum building height: the approved zoned height limit.
protocols.sampling_scope: 总体设计范围内每一高度分区
protocols.frequency_or_trigger: 高度分区批复或调整后一次性赋值
protocols.missing_value_handling: 输入缺失时保持 unassigned，不插值、不以区级或全市平均值替代、不以历史值顺延。
quality_checks: 与批复的高度分区图逐区核对
与视线廊道及文保建设控制要求交叉检查
protocols.dispute_review: 任何居民、维护者、开发者或独立复核角色可在公开值班簿提出质疑；由独立复核角色复算并公开复算过程，原值与更正值并列保留。
protocols.privacy_and_retention: 不涉及个人数据；仅发布公开批复或测绘文件中的数值并标注其出处。
publication_gate: 高度分区批复已公开
视线廊道与文保建设控制要求已明确
protocols.assignment_precondition: 审定高度分区与文保建设控制要求。
protocols.aggregation_method_zh: 不适用统计估计——按高度分区并列登记。**不取各分区最大值代表全带**，那会把一处高点读成普遍允许高度。
protocols.aggregation_method_en: No statistical estimation applies — recorded per height zone. **The maximum across zones is not used to represent the belt**, which would read one tall point as a generally permitted height.
protocols.privacy_and_retention_en: No personal data involved; only values from published approval or survey documents are released, each with its source cited.
quality_checks_en: Checked zone by zone against the approved height-zoning drawing
Cross-checked against sightline corridors and heritage construction-control requirements
publication_gate_en: The height-zoning approval is published
Sightline corridors and heritage construction-control requirements are stated
protocols.sampling_scope_en: every height zone within the overall design area
protocols.frequency_or_trigger_en: assigned once after the height zoning is approved or revised

protocols.definition_zh: 范围内现状建筑面积总量：逐栋普查加总，非类型单元外推。
protocols.definition_en: Total existing floor area: summed from a per-building survey, never extrapolated from typology cells.
protocols.sampling_scope: 总体设计范围内全部现状建筑
protocols.frequency_or_trigger: 普查完成后一次性赋值，其后随许可变更更新
protocols.missing_value_handling: 输入缺失时保持 unassigned，不插值、不以区级或全市平均值替代、不以历史值顺延。
quality_checks: 逐栋核对权属与许可面积
抽样 5% 现场复核
与建筑基底面积和层数交叉验算
protocols.dispute_review: 任何居民、维护者、开发者或独立复核角色可在公开值班簿提出质疑；由独立复核角色复算并公开复算过程，原值与更正值并列保留。
protocols.privacy_and_retention: 按栋汇总发布，不发布产权人姓名或联系方式。
publication_gate: 逐栋普查已完成
权属与许可数据可用
抽样复核偏差在可接受范围内
protocols.assignment_precondition: 现状建筑逐栋普查与许可数据。
protocols.aggregation_method_zh: 逐栋普查值直接加总。**禁止用类型单元均值外推未普查建筑**——本包二十个类型单元是设计示范，不是抽样框，用它们外推会把设计假设洗成现状数据。
protocols.aggregation_method_en: Direct summation of building-by-building survey values. **Extrapolating unsurveyed buildings from type-unit averages is prohibited** — the twenty type units are a design demonstration, not a sampling frame, and extrapolating from them would launder design assumptions into existing-condition data.
protocols.privacy_and_retention_en: Published aggregated by building; owner names and contact details are not published.
quality_checks_en: Ownership and permitted areas checked building by building
5% sample verified on site
Cross-computed against building footprint area and storey count
publication_gate_en: The building-by-building survey is complete
Ownership and permit data are available
Sample-verification deviation is within the acceptable range
protocols.sampling_scope_en: all existing buildings within the overall design area
protocols.frequency_or_trigger_en: assigned once the survey is complete, then updated as permits change

protocols.definition_zh: 建筑密度：现状建筑基底面积之和与用地面积之比。
protocols.definition_en: Building density: summed existing building footprint over land area.
protocols.sampling_scope: 总体设计范围内每一控规单元
protocols.frequency_or_trigger: 普查完成后一次性赋值
protocols.denominator: 该单元的法定用地面积
protocols.missing_value_handling: 输入缺失时保持 unassigned，不插值、不以区级或全市平均值替代、不以历史值顺延。
quality_checks: 基底面积由普查数据复算而非由概念几何推得
单元内建筑数量与普查清单一致
protocols.dispute_review: 任何居民、维护者、开发者或独立复核角色可在公开值班簿提出质疑；由独立复核角色复算并公开复算过程，原值与更正值并列保留。
protocols.privacy_and_retention: 按控规单元汇总发布，不发布产权人姓名、联系方式或具体门牌。
publication_gate: 逐栋普查已完成
官方用地边界已发布
protocols.assignment_precondition: 现状建筑逐栋普查与官方用地边界。
protocols.aggregation_method_zh: 先逐单元计算再按单元并列。**需要全带值时必须以官方用地面积为分母整体重算，不得取各单元密度的算术平均**——单元面积不等，算术平均会给小单元过高权重。
protocols.aggregation_method_en: Computed per unit, then listed per unit. **A belt-wide value must be recomputed whole against the official land area; the arithmetic mean of unit densities must not be used** — units differ in area, so the mean over-weights small units.
protocols.privacy_and_retention_en: Published aggregated by control-plan unit; owner names, contact details and street addresses are not published.
quality_checks_en: Footprint areas recomputed from survey data, not derived from the conceptual geometry
Building counts within each unit match the survey list
publication_gate_en: The building-by-building survey is complete
The official land boundary is released
protocols.sampling_scope_en: every control-plan unit within the overall design area
protocols.frequency_or_trigger_en: assigned once the survey is complete

protocols.definition_zh: 道路面积：由官方道路红线与断面宽度界定的道路用地面积。
protocols.definition_en: Road area: road land area defined by official redlines and cross-section widths.
protocols.sampling_unit: 以交叉口为界的道路段
protocols.sampling_scope: 总体设计范围内全部道路段
protocols.frequency_or_trigger: 道路红线发布或调整后一次性赋值
protocols.missing_value_handling: 输入缺失时保持 unassigned，不插值、不以区级或全市平均值替代、不以历史值顺延。
quality_checks: 以红线面积复算而非以中心线长度换算
相邻段接缝无重叠或缝隙
protocols.dispute_review: 任何居民、维护者、开发者或独立复核角色可在公开值班簿提出质疑；由独立复核角色复算并公开复算过程，原值与更正值并列保留。
protocols.privacy_and_retention: 不涉及个人数据；仅发布公开批复或测绘文件中的数值并标注其出处。
publication_gate: 官方道路红线已发布
断面宽度已明确
protocols.assignment_precondition: 官方道路红线与断面宽度。
protocols.aggregation_method_zh: 逐路段加总，**交叉口面积只计入一次**（按相邻路段的红线中线划分归属），避免两侧路段重复计入同一交叉口。
protocols.aggregation_method_en: Summed segment by segment, with **each junction counted once** (attributed by the centre line between adjoining right-of-way lines), so the same junction is not double-counted from both sides.
protocols.privacy_and_retention_en: No personal data involved; only values from published approval or survey documents are released, each with its source cited.
quality_checks_en: Recomputed from right-of-way polygon area, not converted from centre-line length
No overlaps or gaps at the joints between adjoining segments
publication_gate_en: The official road right-of-way lines are released
Cross-section widths are stated
protocols.sampling_unit_en: one road segment bounded by junctions
protocols.sampling_scope_en: all road segments within the overall design area
protocols.frequency_or_trigger_en: assigned once the road right-of-way lines are released or revised

protocols.definition_zh: 道路率：道路面积与官方场地面积之比。
protocols.definition_en: Road ratio: road area over official site area.
protocols.frequency_or_trigger: 道路面积与官方场地面积同时可用后赋值
protocols.missing_value_handling: 输入缺失时保持 unassigned，不插值、不以区级或全市平均值替代、不以历史值顺延。
quality_checks: 分子分母同源同期
与 road_area_sqm 一致
protocols.dispute_review: 任何居民、维护者、开发者或独立复核角色可在公开值班簿提出质疑；由独立复核角色复算并公开复算过程，原值与更正值并列保留。
protocols.privacy_and_retention: 不涉及个人数据；仅发布公开批复或测绘文件中的数值并标注其出处。
publication_gate: road_area_sqm 已赋值
官方场地面积已发布
protocols.assignment_precondition: 官方道路红线与官方场地边界。
protocols.aggregation_method_zh: 单一比值。**分子与分母必须来自同一发布批次**——道路红线与场地边界若跨批次相除，分母变了而分子没变，比值的变化不代表道路建设的变化。
protocols.aggregation_method_en: A single ratio. **Numerator and denominator must come from the same release batch** — dividing a right-of-way area by a site boundary from a different batch changes the denominator without changing the numerator, so movement in the ratio would not reflect any road being built.
protocols.privacy_and_retention_en: No personal data involved; only values from published approval or survey documents are released, each with its source cited.
quality_checks_en: Numerator and denominator from the same source and period
Consistent with road_area_sqm
publication_gate_en: road_area_sqm is assigned
The official site area is released
protocols.sampling_unit_en: the overall design area as a whole
protocols.sampling_scope_en: the overall design area as a whole
protocols.frequency_or_trigger_en: assigned once road area and official site area are both available

protocols.definition_zh: 更新后区域规划建筑总规模：更新实施后范围内规划建筑面积总量。
protocols.definition_en: Renewed building scale: total planned floor area within the area after renewal.
protocols.sampling_scope: 总体设计范围内每一更新单元
protocols.frequency_or_trigger: 各单元规划条件核发后累加更新
protocols.missing_value_handling: 输入缺失时保持 unassigned，不插值、不以区级或全市平均值替代、不以历史值顺延。
quality_checks: 与规划条件逐单元核对
与 total_floor_area_sqm 的增减关系可追溯
protocols.dispute_review: 任何居民、维护者、开发者或独立复核角色可在公开值班簿提出质疑；由独立复核角色复算并公开复算过程，原值与更正值并列保留。
protocols.privacy_and_retention: 按控规单元汇总发布，不发布产权人姓名、联系方式或具体门牌。
publication_gate: 各单元规划条件已核发
现状建筑面积已赋值
protocols.assignment_precondition: 更新单元规划条件与现状建筑面积。
protocols.aggregation_method_zh: 逐更新单元累加，随规划条件核发滚动更新；**撤销或调整的单元同步扣减，不保留已撤销单元的贡献**——只加不减会让累计值单调上升，失去指示意义。
protocols.aggregation_method_en: Accumulated per renewal unit and rolled forward as planning conditions are issued; **withdrawn or revised units are deducted in step and a withdrawn unit's contribution is not retained** — an add-only total would rise monotonically and lose any indicative meaning.
protocols.privacy_and_retention_en: Published aggregated by control-plan unit; owner names, contact details and street addresses are not published.
quality_checks_en: Checked unit by unit against issued planning conditions
Its increase or decrease relative to total_floor_area_sqm is traceable
publication_gate_en: Planning conditions have been issued for each unit
total_floor_area_sqm is assigned
protocols.sampling_scope_en: every renewal unit within the overall design area
protocols.frequency_or_trigger_en: accumulated as planning conditions are issued for each unit

protocols.definition_zh: AI创新指数：由公共问题响应、开放贡献与复用、测试安全与退出、无AI等价服务可用性四项可核验子项加权，仅采用可公开复算的记录。
protocols.definition_en: AI innovation index: weighted from four publicly recomputable sub-items — civic problem response, open contribution and reuse, test safety and exit, and no-AI equivalent availability.
protocols.sampling_unit: 一带范围内单个场景的一个运行周期
protocols.sampling_scope: 十二个场景全部运行周期
protocols.frequency_or_trigger: 每季度一次，且任一场景停用时即时补记
protocols.denominator: 当期已授权运行的场景数
protocols.missing_value_handling: 输入缺失时保持 unassigned，不插值、不以区级或全市平均值替代、不以历史值顺延。
quality_checks: 四项子项分别可独立复算
台账条目均可回到原始记录
停用与失败记录不得省略
protocols.dispute_review: 任何居民、维护者、开发者或独立复核角色可在公开值班簿提出质疑；由独立复核角色复算并公开复算过程，原值与更正值并列保留。
protocols.privacy_and_retention: 仅发布聚合值；不采集也不发布人脸、身份、住址、个人轨迹或订单明细。单元内样本不足 5 时并入相邻单元后发布。
publication_gate: 公开贡献台账已建立并可查
场景运行记录含正负结果
四项子项权重经公开征求意见
protocols.assignment_precondition: 一带范围内的公开贡献台账与场景运行记录。
protocols.aggregation_method_zh: 四项子项各自先在**场景层**计算，再以当期已授权运行的场景数为分母取算术平均。**停用场景计入分母、不计入分子**——否则关掉表现差的场景就能提高指数，这条是为了让指数不能靠减少暴露面来改善。不做跨季度平滑，逐季原值全部保留。
protocols.aggregation_method_en: Each of the four sub-items is computed at **scenario level** first, then averaged over the number of scenarios authorised to run in that period. **A suspended scenario stays in the denominator and leaves the numerator** — otherwise switching off a poorly performing scenario would raise the index; this rule exists so the index cannot be improved by reducing exposure. No smoothing across quarters; every quarterly raw value is retained.
protocols.privacy_and_retention_en: Only aggregate values are published; faces, identities, addresses, individual movement traces and order-level records are neither collected nor published. Where a unit holds fewer than 5 samples it is merged into an adjacent unit before release.
quality_checks_en: Each of the four sub-items is independently recomputable
Every ledger entry traces back to an original record
Suspension and failure records must not be omitted
publication_gate_en: The public contribution ledger exists and is inspectable
Scenario operation records include both positive and negative results
The four sub-item weights have been through public consultation
protocols.sampling_unit_en: one operating period of one scenario within the belt
protocols.sampling_scope_en: all operating periods of the twelve scenarios
protocols.frequency_or_trigger_en: quarterly, plus an immediate entry whenever any scenario is suspended
protocols.denominator_en: the number of scenarios authorised to operate in that period

protocols.definition_zh: 人才密度：单位就业用地上的AI相关从业与在学人口，按官方统计口径。
protocols.definition_en: Talent density: AI-related workforce and students per unit of employment land, on official statistical definitions.
protocols.sampling_scope: 总体设计范围覆盖的全部统计小区
protocols.frequency_or_trigger: 官方统计年度发布后一次性赋值
protocols.denominator: 该统计小区的就业用地面积
protocols.missing_value_handling: 输入缺失时保持 unassigned，不插值、不以区级或全市平均值替代、不以历史值顺延。
quality_checks: 就业与学籍口径与发布机构一致
用地面积与官方权属数据一致
不以企业自报数据替代
protocols.dispute_review: 任何居民、维护者、开发者或独立复核角色可在公开值班簿提出质疑；由独立复核角色复算并公开复算过程，原值与更正值并列保留。
protocols.privacy_and_retention: 仅发布聚合值；不采集也不发布人脸、身份、住址、个人轨迹或订单明细。单元内样本不足 5 时并入相邻单元后发布。
publication_gate: 官方就业与学籍统计已发布
用地权属数据可用
统计小区与设计范围的空间对应关系已确认
protocols.assignment_precondition: 官方就业、学籍统计与用地权属数据。
protocols.aggregation_method_zh: 逐统计小区计算后**以就业用地面积为权重加权**，不取小区算术平均——小区面积差异大，未加权会让小面积小区主导结果。
protocols.aggregation_method_en: Computed per statistical district, then **weighted by employment land area**, not averaged arithmetically — district areas vary widely and an unweighted mean would let small districts dominate.
protocols.privacy_and_retention_en: Only aggregate values are published; faces, identities, addresses, individual movement traces and order-level records are neither collected nor published. Where a unit holds fewer than 5 samples it is merged into an adjacent unit before release.
quality_checks_en: Employment and enrolment definitions match the publishing agency's
Land areas match official ownership data
Company self-reported data is not substituted
publication_gate_en: Official employment and enrolment statistics are published
Land-ownership data are available
The spatial correspondence between statistical districts and the design area is confirmed
protocols.sampling_scope_en: all statistical districts covered by the overall design area
protocols.frequency_or_trigger_en: assigned once the official annual statistics are published

protocols.definition_zh: 产值规模：统计口径内AI及“AI+”融合产业年度产值。
protocols.definition_en: Output scale: annual output of AI and AI-plus industries within the statistical definition.
protocols.sampling_scope: 统计部门界定的产业范围与地域范围
protocols.frequency_or_trigger: 官方统计年度发布后一次性赋值
protocols.missing_value_handling: 输入缺失时保持 unassigned，不插值、不以区级或全市平均值替代、不以历史值顺延。
quality_checks: 产业范围与统计部门口径一致
地域范围与设计范围的差异明确标注
不以区级数值直接充当走廊数值
protocols.dispute_review: 任何居民、维护者、开发者或独立复核角色可在公开值班簿提出质疑；由独立复核角色复算并公开复算过程，原值与更正值并列保留。
protocols.privacy_and_retention: 仅发布统计部门已公开的汇总值并标注口径与年度，不涉及个人数据。
publication_gate: 统计部门口径已明确
地域范围与设计范围的对应关系已说明
protocols.assignment_precondition: 统计部门口径与企业名录。
protocols.aggregation_method_zh: 直接采用统计部门发布值。**方案不重算、不换算口径、不按面积或人口比例把全区产值分摊到本带**——那样得到的是不可复核的伪精度。
protocols.aggregation_method_en: The statistics authority's published figure is used as is. **This package does not recompute it, does not convert its basis, and does not apportion district-wide output to the belt by area or population** — doing so would produce unverifiable false precision.
protocols.privacy_and_retention_en: Only the statistics authority's already-published aggregate is released, with its basis and year cited; no personal data involved.
quality_checks_en: Industry scope matches the statistics authority's basis
Any difference between its geographic scope and the design area is explicitly stated
District-level figures are not used directly as corridor figures
publication_gate_en: The statistics authority's basis is stated
The correspondence between its geographic scope and the design area is explained
protocols.sampling_scope_en: the industry and geographic scope defined by the statistics authority
protocols.frequency_or_trigger_en: assigned once the official annual statistics are published

protocols.definition_zh: AI企业聚集目标：范围内AI企业与研发机构的数量目标。
protocols.definition_en: AI enterprise clustering target: the target count of AI enterprises and research institutions in the area.
protocols.frequency_or_trigger: 主管部门设定目标后记录，方案不代为设定
protocols.missing_value_handling: 输入缺失时保持 unassigned，不插值、不以区级或全市平均值替代、不以历史值顺延。
quality_checks: 目标值出处为主管部门公开文件
统计口径与企业名录一致
protocols.dispute_review: 任何居民、维护者、开发者或独立复核角色可在公开值班簿提出质疑；由独立复核角色复算并公开复算过程，原值与更正值并列保留。
protocols.privacy_and_retention: 仅记录主管部门公开文件中的目标值并标注出处，不涉及个人数据。
publication_gate: 主管部门已公开目标值
企业名录口径已明确
protocols.assignment_precondition: 产业主管部门的目标决策与企业名录。
protocols.aggregation_method_zh: 不适用——目标值由产业主管部门设定。**本方案既不代为设定，也不给出建议区间**：给出一个'参考数'会在后续被引用成本方案的承诺。
protocols.aggregation_method_en: Not applicable — the target is set by the competent industry authority. **This package neither sets it nor offers a suggested range**: publishing a "reference figure" would later be cited as a commitment by this package.
protocols.privacy_and_retention_en: Only the target stated in the competent authority's published document is recorded, with its source cited; no personal data involved.
quality_checks_en: The target originates in a published document of the competent authority
Statistical basis matches the company register
publication_gate_en: The competent authority has published the target
The company-register basis is stated
protocols.frequency_or_trigger_en: recorded once the competent authority sets the target; this proposal does not set it on their behalf

protocols.definition_zh: 主轴最大纵坡：沿慢行主轴 ROAD-001 逐段计算纵坡后取绝对值最大者，用于判断连续无障碍通行是否成立。
protocols.definition_en: Maximum longitudinal gradient of the spine: computed segment by segment along the slow-mobility spine ROAD-001, taking the largest absolute value, used to judge whether continuous barrier-free passage holds.
protocols.sampling_unit: 主轴上以坡度转折点为界的一个纵断面区间
protocols.sampling_scope: ROAD-001 全线，另在八处东西缝合支线交汇点加密
protocols.frequency_or_trigger: 现状纵断面测量完成后一次性赋值；此后主轴或任一支线交汇点竖向改造后该区间重测
protocols.denominator: 该区间的水平投影长度
protocols.aggregation_method_zh: **取全线最大值，不取平均值也不取分位数**——纵坡的约束是逐点成立的，一处超限就阻断连续通行，用均值或 P90 会把一个断点稀释成合格。八处支线交汇点的区间单独列出并单独判定，不并入全线最大值取代。
protocols.aggregation_method_en: **The line-wide maximum is taken; neither a mean nor a percentile** — a gradient constraint holds point by point, and a single over-limit location breaks continuous passage, so a mean or P90 would dilute one break into a pass. The intervals at the eight stitching-line junctions are listed and judged separately rather than being absorbed into the line-wide maximum.
protocols.missing_value_handling: 输入缺失时保持 unassigned，不插值、不以区级或全市平均值替代、不以历史值顺延。
quality_checks: 高程数据的垂直基准与水平坐标系一并记录
坡度转折点划分与实测断面一致，不按等距人为切分
八处支线交汇点区间逐处单列，不并入全线统计
quality_checks_en: The vertical datum of the elevation data is recorded together with the horizontal coordinate system
Break points match the surveyed profile rather than being cut at arbitrary equal intervals
Each of the eight junction intervals is listed separately and not folded into the line-wide statistic
protocols.dispute_review: 任何居民、维护者、开发者或独立复核角色可在公开值班簿提出质疑；由独立复核角色复算并公开复算过程，原值与更正值并列保留。
protocols.privacy_and_retention: 不涉及个人数据；仅发布纵断面测量得到的坡度值与其垂直基准，并标注测量单位与日期。
protocols.privacy_and_retention_en: No personal data involved; only the gradient values obtained from the profile survey and their vertical datum are released, with the surveying party and date cited.
publication_gate: 现状纵断面测量已完成且垂直基准已记录
无障碍规范的坡度与休息平台限值口径已明确
八处支线交汇点的竖向衔接方案已可判定
publication_gate_en: The existing longitudinal profile survey is complete and its vertical datum recorded
The gradient and landing limits in the barrier-free code are stated
The vertical connection at each of the eight junctions is determinable
protocols.assignment_precondition: 现状纵断面测量数据与无障碍规范限值口径。
protocols.sampling_unit_en: one profile interval on the spine bounded by gradient break points
protocols.sampling_scope_en: the full length of ROAD-001, with denser sampling at the eight stitch-link junctions
protocols.frequency_or_trigger_en: assigned once the existing profile survey is complete; the interval is re-surveyed after any vertical alteration to the spine or a junction
protocols.denominator_en: the horizontal run of that interval

protocols.definition_zh: 上线历时：一项能力从首次在 BUILD 侧交出，到在 SERVE 侧被城市服务方接收为止的日历天数，取中位数。计时从第一次交出起算，中途被拒收并重新提交的等待时间一并计入，不重新起算。
protocols.definition_en: Time to service: calendar days from a capability's first handout on the BUILD side to its acceptance by the city service side on the SERVE side, reported as a median. The clock starts at the first handout and continues through any rejection and resubmission; it is not reset.
protocols.sampling_unit: 一项走完四次交接的能力
protocols.sampling_scope: 三座交接场与公开交接桌 P0 上发生的全部交接
protocols.frequency_or_trigger: 每完成一次 SERVE 侧接收即记一条；每季度汇总一次中位数
protocols.denominator: 当期完成 SERVE 侧接收的能力数
protocols.aggregation_method_zh: **取中位数并同时公布四分位距，不取算术平均**——少数长期挂起的能力会把均值拉成一个谁都没经历过的数。**未走完四次交接的能力不计入分子也不计入分母，但必须单列「在途件数与最长在途天数」**：否则只要把慢的一直挂着不接收，中位数就会越来越好看，这正是本指标最容易被做漂亮的方式。
protocols.aggregation_method_en: **A median is taken and the interquartile range published alongside it; no arithmetic mean** — a few indefinitely suspended capabilities would pull the mean to a value nobody experienced. **Capabilities that have not completed all four handovers enter neither numerator nor denominator, but the count in flight and the longest days in flight must be listed separately**: otherwise simply never accepting the slow ones makes the median look ever better, which is exactly how this metric is most easily flattered.
protocols.missing_value_handling: 输入缺失时保持 unassigned，不插值、不以其他场景数值替代、不以历史值顺延。
quality_checks: 起算时点取第一次交出，不取最近一次重新提交
在途件数与最长在途天数与本期中位数同屏公布
拒收等待期计入历时，不从分子中扣除
quality_checks_en: The clock starts at the first handout, not at the most recent resubmission
The count in flight and the longest days in flight are published on the same screen as the median
Waiting time during rejection counts toward the elapsed days and is not deducted
protocols.dispute_review: 任何居民、维护者、开发者或独立复核角色可在公开值班簿提出质疑；由独立复核角色复算并公开复算过程，原值与更正值并列保留。
protocols.privacy_and_retention: 只登记能力标识、交接时点与角色类型，不记录任何个人姓名、联系方式或所属单位；记录随年度交接账公开留存。
protocols.privacy_and_retention_en: Records only the capability identifier, handover timestamps and role types; no personal name, contact detail or employer is recorded. Records are retained publicly with the annual handover ledger.
publication_gate: 至少一项能力走完 BUILD→VERIFY→SHARE→SERVE 四次交接
四次交接账均可被独立复核角色复算
在途件数与最长在途天数可同期公布
publication_gate_en: At least one capability has completed all four handovers from BUILD through SERVE
All four handover ledgers can be recomputed by the independent review role
The count in flight and the longest days in flight can be published for the same period
protocols.assignment_precondition: 至少一条能力走完四次交接，且四次交接账均可复核。
protocols.sampling_unit_en: one capability that has completed all four handovers
protocols.sampling_scope_en: every handover occurring at the three Handover Yards and the Public Handover Table P0
protocols.frequency_or_trigger_en: one record per acceptance on the SERVE side; medians aggregated quarterly
protocols.denominator_en: the number of capabilities accepted on the SERVE side in the period

protocols.definition_zh: 返工轮次：同一能力在四次交接中被拒收并重新提交的次数，取中位数。只计「拒收后重新提交」，附条件接受不计入；同一次交接被同一理由连续拒收两次计两次。
protocols.definition_en: Rework rounds: how many times the same capability is rejected and resubmitted across the four handovers, reported as a median. Only rejection followed by resubmission counts; conditional acceptance does not. Two consecutive rejections on the same ground at the same handover count as two.
protocols.sampling_unit: 一项至少完成一次交接的能力
protocols.sampling_scope: 三座交接场与公开交接桌 P0 上发生的全部拒收记录
protocols.frequency_or_trigger: 每次拒收并重新提交即记一条；每季度汇总一次中位数
protocols.denominator: 当期至少完成一次交接的能力数
protocols.aggregation_method_zh: **按 R1—R7 的拒收理由分类并列公布，不合并成一个总数**——「因未闭合项被拒」与「因角色未指派被拒」是两种完全不同的问题，合并后无法据以改进。**本指标下降不自动等于变好**：拒收变少也可能是复核变松，因此必须与 HV-01 交接完整率同屏读；两者一升一降时以 HV-01 为准。
protocols.aggregation_method_en: **Published side by side under the R1–R7 rejection grounds, never merged into a single total** — "rejected for an unclosed item" and "rejected because a role was unassigned" are entirely different problems and cannot guide improvement once merged. **A fall in this metric does not automatically mean improvement**: fewer rejections may mean laxer review, so it must be read on the same screen as HV-01 handover completeness; where the two move in opposite directions, HV-01 governs.
protocols.missing_value_handling: 输入缺失时保持 unassigned，不插值、不以其他场景数值替代、不以历史值顺延。
quality_checks: 每条拒收记录均有按 R1—R7 归类的书面理由
重新提交与首次提交之间的对应关系可追溯
与同期 HV-01 交接完整率并列公布
quality_checks_en: Every rejection record carries a written ground classified under R1–R7
Each resubmission is traceable to its original submission
Published alongside HV-01 handover completeness for the same period
protocols.dispute_review: 任何居民、维护者、开发者或独立复核角色可在公开值班簿提出质疑；由独立复核角色复算并公开复算过程，原值与更正值并列保留。
protocols.privacy_and_retention: 只登记能力标识、拒收理由类别与角色类型，不记录拒收者与被拒方的姓名或所属单位；记录随年度交接账公开留存。
protocols.privacy_and_retention_en: Records only the capability identifier, the rejection-ground category and role types; neither the rejecting nor the rejected party is named by person or employer. Records are retained publicly with the annual handover ledger.
publication_gate: 拒收理由已按 R1—R7 归类且可复核
重新提交与首次提交之间已建立对应关系
同期 HV-01 交接完整率可一并公布
publication_gate_en: Rejection grounds are classified under R1–R7 and can be recomputed
Each resubmission is linked to its original submission
HV-01 handover completeness for the same period can be published with it
protocols.assignment_precondition: 拒收理由已按 R1—R7 归类且可复核，重新提交与首次提交之间可建立对应关系。
protocols.sampling_unit_en: one capability that has completed at least one handover
protocols.sampling_scope_en: every rejection record at the three Handover Yards and the Public Handover Table P0
protocols.frequency_or_trigger_en: one record per rejection-and-resubmission; medians aggregated quarterly
protocols.denominator_en: the number of capabilities completing at least one handover in the period

aggregation_method_notice: 本字段回答的是「数值将来怎么算出来」，与 definition_zh（是什么）和 publication_gate（什么条件下才发布）分开。十四项中有三项标注「不适用」——它们是主管部门审定值或由主管部门设定的目标，不是估计量，为它们编造一套统计方法会把法定决定伪装成本方案的测算。其余各项写明的多数是**禁止性规则**（不外推、不取算术平均、不跨批次相除、不分摊、停用不改善指数）：这些是实践中最容易出错、也最容易被用来把数字做好看的地方，因此写成方法的一部分而不是注意事项。
